# ElementCycleError

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Thrown when an element contains itself, directly or through its descendants. Such a tree has no end, so it is rejected before layout instead of recursing until the stack overflows.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`. Extends `BonniePdfError`.

## Constructors

```typescript
new ElementCycleError(elementType: string)
```
